_comment: Adding an entry is a ruling routed to @system_adamic. Valid, type-correct programs must never be listed. Schema: witnesses maps SHA-256 of exact source bytes to form (empty for literal type lies), ruling_task, ruling, declaration (file:line), declared_type, repair_from, repair_to, type_correct_sha256, exit (70), stderr (exact bytes; {root} expands to the head checkout). Repair replaces every repair_from with repair_to; its hash can never be listed. Supported literal type lies are string = undefined!/null! and number asserted from a callback returning the string literal wrong. The checked_boundary form (form, ruling; #995z2fa, Adamic, Oct 25) is a type lie a checked view's own read or write stops with its located message, adamic: panic: field read failed: ..., whose expected or found type is declared_type; its repair replaces one place and must agree with Node. No name lookup; an edit requires Node agreement or a new ruling.
